# The Apache Software Foundation

> The Apache Software Foundation stewards hundreds of open source projects and provides governance, community, legal, security, and infrastructure resources for the Apache ecosystem.

Apache.org is the central hub for ASF projects, contributor guidance, foundation policies, licensing, security reporting, events, and organizational documentation. It connects top-level project sites with ASF-wide resources for developers, committers, PMC members, and the broader open source community.

## Foundation Overview
- [Apache Software Foundation Home](https://apache.org/): Main entry point for ASF projects, community initiatives, events, and foundation resources.
- [Projects](https://apache.org/projects): Overview of Apache top-level and incubating projects across the foundation.
- [Projects Directory](https://projects.apache.org/): Searchable directory of projects, podlings, committees, and metadata.
- [How the ASF Works](https://apache.org/foundation/how-it-works): Explains ASF governance, roles, decision-making, and organizational structure.
- [The Apache Way](https://apache.org/theapacheway/): Describes Apache’s community-driven development model and meritocratic culture.
- [Glossary](https://apache.org/foundation/glossary): Definitions for common ASF governance, community, and project terminology.
- [FAQ](https://apache.org/foundation/faq): Answers to frequently asked questions about ASF operations and participation.

## Projects, Releases, and Downloads
- [Projects](https://apache.org/projects): Browse Apache software projects and links to their homepages.
- [Projects Directory](https://projects.apache.org/): Detailed project records, committees, releases, and repository metadata.
- [Releases Directory](https://projects.apache.org/releases.html): Aggregated listing of Apache project releases and release information.
- [Downloads](https://downloads.apache.org/): Official distribution mirror for Apache software release artifacts.
- [Apache Security](https://apache.org/security): Central page for vulnerability reporting and security contacts.
- [Apache Licenses](https://apache.org/licenses): ASF software licensing policies, approved licenses, and guidance.

## Incubator and New Projects
- [Apache Incubator](https://incubator.apache.org/): Entry point for podlings, incubation process, and mentor resources.
- [Incubating Projects](https://incubator.apache.org/projects/): Current podlings and their incubation status.
- [Incubation Process](https://incubator.apache.org/process/index.html): Describes how projects enter, operate within, and graduate from incubation.
- [Incubation Policy](https://incubator.apache.org/policy/incubation.html): Formal policy governing incubation, oversight, and podling responsibilities.
- [Incubator Guides](https://incubator.apache.org/guides/index.html): Practical guidance for podlings, mentors, and incubator participants.
- [Incubate a Project](https://incubator.apache.org/guides/proposal.html): Proposal guidance for bringing a project into the Apache Incubator.

## Community and Contribution
- [Contributor Getting Started](https://community.apache.org/): Starting point for new contributors joining Apache communities and projects.
- [Becoming a Committer](https://community.apache.org/contributors/): Explains the contributor ladder and path toward committership.
- [Community Resources](https://apache.org/community-resources/): ASF-wide resources for participation, mentoring, and community support.
- [Mailing Lists](https://apache.org/foundation/mailinglists): Information about ASF mailing lists and community communication channels.
- [Developer Information](https://apache.org/dev/): Technical and procedural resources for Apache project developers.
- [Code of Conduct](https://apache.org/foundation/policies/conduct): Community behavior expectations and reporting guidance for misconduct.
- [Donate](https://donate.apache.org/48ff): Support the ASF’s infrastructure, programs, and open source mission.

## Governance, Policy, and Legal
- [How the ASF Works](https://apache.org/foundation/how-it-works): Overview of boards, PMCs, members, officers, and project governance.
- [Foundation Policies](https://apache.org/foundation/policies/): Index of ASF policies covering community and operational matters.
- [Code of Conduct](https://apache.org/foundation/policies/conduct): Official conduct policy for ASF spaces and interactions.
- [Legal Affairs](https://apache.org/legal/): Legal guidance on trademarks, copyright, licensing, and third-party use.
- [Licenses](https://apache.org/licenses): Apache License information and related licensing documentation.
- [Apache License, Version 2.0](https://apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0): Full text of the Apache License 2.0.
- [Trademark Policy](https://apache.org/foundation/marks/): Rules for using Apache names, logos, and project trademarks.

## Security and Compliance
- [Security](https://apache.org/security): Instructions for reporting vulnerabilities affecting Apache projects or infrastructure.
- [Security Team](https://apache.org/security/team.html): Information about the ASF Security Team and its role.
- [Vulnerability Reporting](https://apache.org/security/committers.html): Guidance for project teams handling vulnerabilities and disclosures.
- [Security Announcements](https://apache.org/security/): Central source for ASF security reporting information.
- [Export Control and Cryptography](https://apache.org/licenses/exports/): Guidance related to export regulations and cryptographic software.
- [Resolved Security Reports](https://apache.org/security/#reports): Published security reports and issue tracking references.

## Infrastructure and Developer Operations
- [Developer Information](https://apache.org/dev/): Central hub for release, repository, and project operations guidance.
- [Infrastructure](https://infra.apache.org/): ASF infrastructure services, status, and operational documentation.
- [Infrastructure Services](https://infra.apache.org/services.html): Overview of services available to Apache projects and contributors.
- [Git at Apache](https://gitbox.apache.org/): ASF Git hosting and repository management service.
- [Self-Service Portal](https://selfserve.apache.org/): Administrative self-service tools for Apache project communities.
- [Whimsy](https://whimsy.apache.org/): ASF governance and project administration tools used by members and PMCs.

## Events and Programs
- [Events](https://events.apache.org/): ASF event calendar for conferences, meetups, and community activities.
- [Community Over Code](https://communityovercode.org/): ASF’s flagship community conference and event series.
- [ApacheCon Archive](https://apachecon.com/): Historical ApacheCon conference information and related event materials.
- [ASF Plus One](https://news.apache.org/foundation/entry/category/plus-one-newsletter): Newsletter updates about ASF community and foundation news.
- [Google Summer of Code](https://community.apache.org/gsoc.html): ASF participation information for Google Summer of Code.
- [Travel Assistance](https://community.apache.org/travel-assistance.html): Community support information for attending ASF events and programs.

## News, Blog, and Media
- [ASF Blog](https://news.apache.org/): Official Apache Software Foundation news and blog posts.
- [Foundation News](https://news.apache.org/foundation/entry): Foundation announcements, initiatives, and organizational updates.
- [Project News](https://news.apache.org/foundation/entry/category/projects): News related to Apache projects and releases.
- [Press Kit](https://apache.org/press/): Media resources, logos, and background information about the ASF.
- [Press Releases](https://apache.org/press/pressreleases): Official ASF press release archive.
- [Brand Guidelines](https://apache.org/foundation/press/kit/): Foundation branding and media usage resources.

## Foundation Support and Public Information
- [Sponsors](https://apache.org/foundation/sponsorship.html): Information about sponsoring the ASF and supporting its mission.
- [Thanks to Sponsors](https://apache.org/foundation/thanks.html): Recognition of organizations supporting the Apache Software Foundation.
- [Contact the ASF](https://apache.org/foundation/contact): Contact information for foundation-related inquiries.
- [Who We Are](https://apache.org/foundation/): Overview of the foundation’s mission, structure, and public information.
- [Board of Directors](https://apache.org/foundation/board/): Information about the ASF Board and board meeting materials.
- [Members](https://apache.org/foundation/members): Information about ASF membership and the member community.
